title: Sprint 2 — Files, Permissions & Text Processing
description: Master file operations, ownership models, and become proficient in text processing.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — File Operations & Archiving
tickets.description:
Safely create, copy, move, and manage files and directories.
Learn to archive and compress files efficiently.
Understand the differences between various types of file links.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.1 — CRUD Operations
tasks.description: Build directory structures and practice essential file operations such as copying, moving, and securely removing data.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.2 — tar, gzip, zip
tasks.description: Learn how to bundle multiple files into archives and compress them to save storage space.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.3 — Links: Hard vs Soft
tasks.description: Create different types of file links and observe how they behave when original files are modified or deleted.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Permissions, Ownership & ACLs
tickets.description:
Configure access permissions using various notations.
Understand special permissions and their security implications.
Apply default permissions and extended access control lists.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.1 — chmod & chown
tasks.description: Practice securing files by assigning precise permissions and changing file ownership to specific users and groups.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.2 — Special Permissions
tasks.description: Explore advanced permission settings and understand how they impact system security and executable behaviors.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.3 — umask & ACLs
tasks.description: Configure default permissions for new files and establish fine-grained access control rules for specific users.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Text Processing Power Tools
tickets.description:
Extract specific information from logs using pattern matching.
Perform automated text transformations on data streams.
Aggregate and analyze structured data efficiently.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.1 — grep & regex
tasks.description: Learn to search through text files and extract specific patterns like IP addresses, dates, or error codes using regular expressions.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.2 — sed & Stream Editing
tasks.description: Automate text editing tasks by performing in-place substitutions, deletions, and multi-line transformations on configuration files.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.3 — awk for Reporting
tasks.description: Process structured data files to calculate totals, filter information based on thresholds, and generate formatted reports.
